explanations.answer: Builds it up all the way around
explanations.explanation: You got it, baker. David takes up residence in the fortress, calls it the City of David, and builds it up “…all the way around, from the supporting terraces inward.” (2 Samuel 5:9) He's not just visiting. He moves in and gets to work.

explanations.answer: Gives it back to the Jebusites
explanations.explanation: No way, friend. After taking that fortress, David isn't handing the keys back. The text says he took up residence there and built it up “…all the way around, from the supporting terraces inward.” (2 Samuel 5:9) He moved in.

explanations.answer: Leaves it to go back to Hebron
explanations.explanation: Not this time, friend. David doesn't head back to Hebron. He takes up residence in the fortress, calls it the City of David, and builds it up “…all the way around, from the supporting terraces inward.” (2 Samuel 5:9) He's staying put.
